name: Nationalism
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly established nations and set their boundaries, as seen in Deuteronomy 32:8, where the Most High divided the earth among peoples. While the earth belongs to the Lord (Exodus 19:5), He calls His people to be a distinct treasure and to seek the peace of the cities where they dwell (Jeremiah 29:7). The Bible also emphasizes compassion toward strangers within the land (Leviticus 19:33) and recognizes the blessing upon a nation whose God is the LORD (Psalms 33:12), highlighting a balance between national identity and faithfulness to God.
